instructions: Each case must point to closed 5m candles covering enough history to build complete 1M/1W/1D/4H/1H/15m context.
Timestamp is the exact evaluation time; future candles must not affect the observation.
Labels describe structure and setup state only. Profit, future return, TP hit and SL hit fields are forbidden.
A screenshot or Drive source may be recorded as traceability metadata but is not parsed as a trading result.
h1_reaction is diagnostic; the raid path requires a fresh h1_raid, while the VC path requires h1_vc plus vc_zone_test before 5m BOS.
Recognition fixes are permitted only when the engine disagrees with the documented strategy definition, not because of later PnL.
